title: New tall white arrivals come too close at Range Three
place_text: Range Three, Indian Springs Valley, Nevada

tellings.quote: One night I was out in range three and a group of new arrivals, it was after the full moon, a week or so,

plain: One night in 1965, about a week after the full moon, a group of newly arrived tall white beings came too close to a man working out on Range Three, a stretch of test range in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada. Charles Hall tells this as his own experience, from the three years he says he spent around these beings, whom he calls Tall White aliens, while stationed in the Nevada desert. If true, it would mean non-human visitors lived alongside US military staff there.
